syllabus_name: AI, Data Science with Python & SQL - TTNT, KHDL với Python và SQL
course_name_english: AI, Data Science with Python & SQL
description: The course covers relational database concepts, foundational knowledge of the SQL language. The students will learn some popular tools for data science, understand a methodology that can be used within data science, meet some data science practitioner, understand data gathering, summarize data using descriptive statistics, display and visualize data.
tools:
Jupyter Notebooks
- JupyterLab
- RStudio IDE
- Git, GitHub
-Watson Studio.
